mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 5.0% triggers inflationary concerns, leading to reduced investor confidence and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: When UNRATE crosses above 5.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDPC1 (total chained-dollar demand) and HOUST (units of output) signals robust economic activity, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST increase, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Conflicting signals of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS >4.5%) and labor market strength (UNRATE <5.0%) create market uncertainty, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS >4.5% and UNRATE <5.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate amplifies equity valuation gains through reduced borrowing costs, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, when FEDFUNDS decreases, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 210.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 210.0 in the next month
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL crosses above 210.0, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in employment (PAYEMS) boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases in the next month
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases, 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply index) reduces production costs and inflationary pressures, enhancing corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO increases, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.
